display.purpose: The song title field — the largest text on the page.

body.purpose: Toolbar and nav buttons, sidebar rows, comment textareas.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked metadata: tuning readout, sync readout, measure labels.

mono.purpose: Everything inside the editable grid — fret numbers, note names, BPM. Monospace signals editable data, never decoration.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Centered dialogs (tuning editor, welcome, import conflicts) over a bg-black/70 scrim.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Section-link menu, shortcut help, section-gap insert popover.

shadows.name: floating-widget
shadows.purpose: The Sound panel and toast — elements detached from the page. Collapsed variant: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.4).

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover/active feedback on buttons, tabs, cells. Never shadow transitions.

motion.name: playhead-glide
motion.purpose: The playhead overlay translates across the line instead of jumping cell to cell.

components.name: Primary Button (Play)
components.description: The single default action — transport Play and sidebar Save. Solid crimson, plate-dark text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d65a48; color: #171511; font: 500 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; padding: 6px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d65a48; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Standard Key Button
components.description: The majority action button: a struck key one tonal step up from the ground with a hairline edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-key { background: #2a2620; color: #ece6d8; font: 400 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #4c4638; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-key:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #9c9382; } .ds-btn-key:disabled { opacity: 0.35; }

components.name: Danger Key Button
components.description: Same key, hovering to crimson instead of ink — remove/delete actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #2a2620; color: #ece6d8; font: 400 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #4c4638; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { color: #d65a48; border-color: #d65a48; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: No box at rest — text sits on the plate over a hairline underline; focus turns the underline crimson.
components.css: .ds-field { background: transparent; color: #ece6d8; font: 400 13px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; padding: 2px 6px; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #4c4638; border-radius: 0; outline: none; caret-color: #d65a48; width: 72px; } .ds-field:focus { border-bottom-color: #d65a48; }

components.name: Volume Slider
components.description: A hairline score for the track, a crimson caret bar for the thumb — the system's position-is-a-line motif.
components.css: .ds-slider { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 96px; height: 14px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slider::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 2px; background: #4c4638; } .ds-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 3px; height: 14px; margin-top: -6px; background: #d65a48; border: none; border-radius: 0; } .ds-slider::-moz-range-track { height: 2px; background: #4c4638; } .ds-slider::-moz-range-progress { height: 2px; background: #9c9382; } .ds-slider::-moz-range-thumb { width: 3px; height: 14px; background: #d65a48; border: none; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Track Tab
components.description: Every tab carries a visible plate; the active tab steps up a tone and takes the crimson underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; background: #171511; padding: 4px; } .ds-tab { background: #201d18; color: #9aa7b0; font: 400 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(42,38,32,0.6); } .ds-tab-active { background: #2a2620; color: #ece6d8; font-weight: 500; border-bottom-color: #d65a48; }

components.name: Section Chip
components.description: Keyed jump chips in the section bar; the bottom border carries the accent when active or a tie color when linked.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #2a2620; color: #9aa7b0; font: 400 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #4c4638; border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #ece6d8; border-color: #9c9382; } .ds-chip-active { color: #ece6d8; border-bottom-color: #d65a48; }

components.name: Focus Caret Cell
components.description: The signature grid mark: current position is a vertical crimson caret line with a 10% tint fill, never a boxed outline.
components.css: .ds-cells { display: flex; background: #171511; padding: 6px; } .ds-cell { position: relative; width: 28px; height: 27px; background: transparent; color: #9c9382; font: 400 13px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #3a352c; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cell:hover { background: #2a2620; } .ds-cell-focus { border-left: 2px solid #d65a48; background: rgba(214,90,72,0.1); color: #ece6d8; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: The song is not a spreadsheet of cells with a toolbar floating above it; it is a blackened engraving plate under a raking work light, and the tab is the score etched into it. The metal ground is near-black and warm, the staff lines are hairline scores in the plate, and note values sit in the grid like struck type. One color is allowed to move under it — crimson — reserved for the transport and for the state that is actively happening: the focused cell, the playhead, the primary action. Everything else on the plate is ink, in three weights of legibility, never a second hue competing for attention. This world shipped dark-only by explicit direction; corners are square everywhere (border-radius: 0 !important globally), consistent with engraving in metal.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black warm metal ground, light-etched ink text, one crimson accent used sparingly for transport and active-state
One family, Inter, doing every job through weight and size steps, plus JetBrains Mono for the grid and all numeric/note data
Square corners everywhere, hairline dividers instead of cards or shadows for structure
A single floating corner widget (the Sound panel) and a single fixed bottom transport bar are the only two elements that leave the document flow
Stroke icons from lucide-react themed once in Icons.tsx (1em, 1.75px stroke); genuine music notation stays literal Unicode glyphs as earned notation
The focused cell and the playhead share one visual language — a vertical caret line — never a boxed highlight

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Crimson appears only on the actively playing/selected/focused element or a destructive action's hover state — never as a static brand color splashed on chrome. If nothing is active, nothing on screen is crimson except the transport play button.

rules.name: The Three-Ink Rule
rules.body: Text uses exactly three weights of the same ink hue family (full ink, soft slate, faint) to express hierarchy — never a fourth neutral, never a tint of the accent for text color.

rules.name: The Grid-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything living inside the editable tab grid (fret numbers, note names, BPM) is JetBrains Mono; nothing outside the grid is set in the mono face for body text. Monospace signals "this is data you edit," never decoration.

rules.name: The Flat Plate Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest are flat; a shadow appears only when an element has actually left the document flow (modal, popover, floating widget, toast) to signal "this is above the plate," never as ambient polish.

dos: Do keep crimson to the actively-playing/focused/selected element and destructive hover states only.
Do use JetBrains Mono for anything inside the editable grid and reserve it for that role.
Do use square corners everywhere; the global border-radius reset is a committed identity trait.
Do express depth with hairline borders and plate tonal steps before reaching for a shadow.
Do keep the utility bar pinned above the score and every editing/playback action in the fixed bottom transport.
Do add new iconography as lucide-react icons wrapped through Icons.tsx's themed helper.
Do mark current position (focus, playhead, slider thumb) as a vertical caret line, never a boxed outline.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated accent color; the expressive budget is one crimson against warm neutrals.
Don't round any corner; there is no exception, including modals and floating widgets.
Don't add drop shadows to elements that stay in normal document flow.
Don't stack more than one instrument track's grid on screen at once.
Don't reintroduce a serif or second display typeface, or an italic voice, without an explicit fresh request.
Don't reintroduce a vocal/lyric track type; the shared measure-annotation row covers it.
